Payload 4 support and file previews in the edit view. The plugin now sends anonymous usage telemetry. Set `telemetry: false` to turn it off.

```bash
pnpm add @seshuk/payload-plugin-media-preview@beta
```

## What's new

- **Edit view previews.** The file area at the top of the edit view now shows text, code, CSV, Office and other files that Payload can't show. Images, video, audio and PDF keep Payload's own preview.
- **Code viewer.** Text and code open in a read-only editor with syntax highlighting. CSV shows as a table.
- **Download card.** Files with no preview show their name, size and type, with Download and Open buttons.
- **Async adapters.** `resolve()` can be async. It also gets `payload`, `user` and `collectionSlug`.
- **Safer external viewers.** Files served by Payload get a short-lived signed URL, so the viewer never gets your session. An adapter can return its own URL with `signUrl`, for example for private storage. The server checks that the URL is public before it sends it to the viewer.
- **Clear reasons.** When a file can't open in an external viewer, the preview says why: for example, the server is private or the file is too large. Download and Open buttons show under the viewer, so you can still get the file if Microsoft or Google fails to load it.

## Breaking changes

- You need Payload 4 and Node.js 24.15+. For Payload 3, stay on `1.x`.
- The Preview button in the edit view is gone. The preview now shows at the top of the edit view instead. If a collection already sets `upload.admin.components.filePreview`, your value wins. See [Edit View](https://github.com/maximseshuk/payload-plugin-media-preview#edit-view).
- `mode` and `contentMode` move into `field`: `media: { field: { mode: 'fullscreen' } }`. The old keys throw at startup.
- `mediaPreviewField()` and the `field` options now only change the list view column.
- PDF and text files no longer use the Google viewer.
- External viewers (Microsoft, Google) are off by default, because they download your files. Set `externalViewer` to turn them on.
- `contentMode: { document: 'newTab' }` opens the file URL, not an external viewer.
- Two different adapters with the same `name` throw at startup. Give each adapter a unique name.
- `field.position` throws if no field or more than one field matches the name. Named tabs use their name in the path (`seo.title`), not the tab index.
- Removed exports: `MediaPreview` from `/rsc` and `MediaPreviewFieldClient` from `/client`. `/rsc` now exports `MediaPreviewFile`.
- Styles are plain CSS with Payload 4 design tokens, not SCSS.
- Run `payload generate:importmap` after you upgrade.

All changes with code examples: [Migrating from 1.x](https://github.com/maximseshuk/payload-plugin-media-preview#migrating-from-1x).
